timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The man taking tickets didn’t look up.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I’m Aiden. He looked at me. Looked at the six-foot photograph beside the door. Looked back.

timeline.speaker: TICKET
timeline.text: You look better in the picture.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Vegas. After the homecoming. I had been back long enough for these niggas to start charging admission to my problems. Somebody had put angel wings on a photograph of me getting arrested. Cropped out the cuffs, left the officer’s hand on my shoulder. Nigga had a police escort into heaven. I called Tank.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Why there a cover charge at my funeral?

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I heard chewing. Nigga, are you eating?

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I paid the forty. The nigga stamped DECEASED on my wrist.

timeline.speaker: TICKET
timeline.text: That gets you one well drink.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: One? Nigga, the sign says two-drink minimum.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: A nigga behind me shook his head.

timeline.speaker: GUEST
timeline.text: Hold up. Ain’t that the deceased?

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Ticket man looked at my stamp.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The nigga pulled out his phone.

timeline.speaker: GUEST
timeline.text: People gonna think I knew you personally.

timeline.speaker: GUEST
timeline.text: Yeah, but the funeral picture hit different.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Shawna found me beside the chocolate fountain, turning my memorial program upside down.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Why this say I’m survived by eleven children?

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: My wife looked beautiful in black. Slit up one leg, diamond at her throat, hat tilted like she had already forgiven herself. You enjoying widowhood?

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I pulled her close. She put two fingers against my mouth.

timeline.speaker: SHAWNA
timeline.text: Eight minutes. Kitchen. Stay there until we get the case.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Nigga, I could take it right now.

timeline.speaker: SHAWNA
timeline.text: And Silas’s men could start shooting into everybody who paid to eat shrimp.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I straightened up. Mercedes stood beside the stage in a red suit, thumb pressed into her palm. She’d been doing that all week. Silas Gold had stolen the original recordings of her first album. The nigga had locked the drive in a silver case and invited buyers to bid. She could sing every song again. She couldn’t rebuild the demolished studio, recall every musician to the same night, or make her voice crack exactly where it had in the last chorus. She had left that crack in. Said it sounded like her.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Silas lived behind bulletproof glass and sent other niggas out to be unpleasant. Tell him Aiden was dead, though, and suddenly the motherfucker wanted fresh air. Shawna had promised a private auction after the memorial. My watch, my cars, the collection. Silas would bring the recordings so they could settle everything together. Mercedes would inspect the case backstage. Porsche would switch it. I would stay in the fucking kitchen.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Mercedes caught me looking and came to fix my collar.

timeline.speaker: MERCEDES
timeline.text: The thing where this becomes about you.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: My photograph is six feet tall.

timeline.speaker: MERCEDES
timeline.text: Exactly. The nigga has enough publicity.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I stopped smiling. You’ll get your music.

timeline.speaker: MERCEDES
timeline.text: I know. I want to enjoy getting it.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: She squeezed my shoulder and went back to the stage. Shawna kissed me.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Nigga, y’all got one word for me tonight. She turned me toward the door.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: They had hired a full band. Horns, two keyboards, drummer wearing sunglasses he hadn’t removed for either prayer.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Tank took the microphone carrying a plate.

timeline.speaker: TANK
timeline.text: We gathered here because my brother would want these niggas supporting the bar.

timeline.speaker: TANK
timeline.text: Aiden was generous. Nigga gave me the shirt off his back.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I leaned toward the kitchen speaker.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Police was looking for a man in a red shirt.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I pushed through the kitchen door. Shawna held up one finger without turning around.

timeline.speaker: TANK
timeline.text: Came to the station. Told them I hadn’t done shit. Paid everything. Waited six hours. Bought me breakfast.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: My palm rested against the door.

timeline.speaker: TANK
timeline.text: Then the nigga asked for his shirt.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The drummer caught the laugh with a roll. I had to smile. Nigga knew when to hit.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Silas Gold entered in a white fur coat. Four men followed him. Smallest nigga carried the silver case. Biggest had a neck wider than my thigh and an expression like somebody assembled him without the last page.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Tank looked at the closed coffin.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Silas laughed. His niggas joined a second late.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Shawna offered her hand. He bent to kiss it. She moved it just enough that his mouth met his own thumb.

timeline.speaker: SHAWNA
timeline.text: Mercedes inspects them first. We agreed.

timeline.speaker: SILAS
timeline.text: Darling, look at the crowd. Can’t buy timing.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: He took the microphone from Tank and balanced his bottle on my coffin.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The drummer gave them a little tick, tick, tick.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: From the kitchen I mouthed, Nigga, you stole my boat.

timeline.speaker: SILAS
timeline.text: But he was a man of appetite.

timeline.speaker: SILAS
timeline.text: Appetite leaves things unfinished. People unprovided for. I would never presume—

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Silas waited out the laughter with his teeth showing.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The case opened. Silas put his bottle on the coffin and took out the hard drive.

timeline.speaker: SILAS
timeline.text: Perhaps our little lady could sing a tribute. And apologize for some things she’s said about me.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The biggest nigga blocked the backstage doorway. Porsche stood behind him with the duplicate case.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Silas offered Mercedes the microphone. Pulled it back.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The cook looked up from his potatoes.

timeline.speaker: COOK
timeline.text: Nigga, you want me to hold that?

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I looked through the round window.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Shawna saw my hands, looked at the stage, and shifted her chair clear of the aisle.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: A woman near the aisle looked from me to the coffin.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The nigga beside her crossed himself.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: They moved. I passed between them without losing a shrimp.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: From the stage, the drummer lifted one stick and watched me approach.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I stopped beside the smallest nigga.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Silas heard me. Turned so fast the fur collar slapped his mouth.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: He shoved the microphone into its stand and reached inside his coat.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I drove the tray under his wrist. The pistol fired through the ceiling, flew from his hand, and skidded under the piano. Plaster burst over the stage. The trumpet player ducked. Tank tackled two guests behind a table without spilling his drink.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I caught Silas by the coat.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: He grabbed his bottle from the coffin and swung. Glass broke against my shoulder. Pain ran down my arm.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I hit him with the tray.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The drive flew from his other hand. Mercedes caught it against her chest.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The biggest nigga lunged. Porsche hooked his ankle with the duplicate case. He stumbled down the steps into the chair Shawna had picked up.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: He sat carefully among the pieces.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Mercedes tucked the drive inside her jacket. Behind me, another man drew a gun. I saw him in the mirrored wall and ducked as she threw the microphone stand over my head with both hands.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: It hit the nigga across the chest and carried him into the drum kit.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The drummer stood. Looked at his broken cymbal. Looked at the man under it.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Then he hit him with the stool.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Silas wriggled free of his coat. Ran for the steps. Tank caught him around the waist, flung open the coffin with his free hand, and tipped him inside.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The coffin rocked. Lid banged shut.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: A little man in a gold tracksuit sat upright underneath Silas, wearing my spare sunglasses and looking ready to fight the entire funeral.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The little man pointed at Tank.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Tank pointed at the dust hanging over the stage.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The little man climbed over Silas’s stomach and straightened his tracksuit.

timeline.speaker: CORPSE_PERFORMER
timeline.text: I do the surprise. I do the dance. I leave. Ain’t no nigga mentioned wrestling.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Silas’s fourth man backed toward the exit. Tank pointed at him without looking away from me.

timeline.speaker: TANK
timeline.text: Sit your ass down. The nigga hasn’t danced.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The smallest man still held the empty case and a shrimp tail. He lowered the case very slowly.

timeline.speaker: COOK
timeline.text: No the fuck you are not.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Seven minutes to collect the guns, tie up Silas’s men, and convince everybody the bar remained open.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Silas kept trying to sit up in the coffin. The little man eased him down with a sneaker against his forehead.

timeline.speaker: CORPSE_PERFORMER
timeline.text: Stop being in my office, nigga.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: At the sound desk, Mercedes took the drive from her jacket and plugged it in. Files appeared. She chose one, listened through the headphones, and closed her eyes.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Porsche took her hand beneath the table.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I moved closer. Shawna caught my belt and pulled me back.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Mercedes removed the headphones and wiped under one eye.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: She looked around. Overturned flowers. Two men bleeding into memorial napkins. My giant face leaning crookedly against the wall.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Then she went to the stage.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The drummer was fitting a spare cymbal.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: She gave the sound man a track number. A hiss came through the speakers, then saxophone, warm and rough. The band found its rhythm.

timeline.speaker: MERCEDES
timeline.text: Turn that nigga around. I need the room.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: She sang low at first, almost speaking. Bass came underneath. She planted a heel against the monitor and let the next line climb. By the chorus, people stood between fallen chairs finding somebody to dance with.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The little man shut the coffin and started dancing on it.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Porsche laughed with her face turned up. The cook came out with my jacket over his shoulder and a tray in his hands. A woman took the tray, put it on a table, and pulled him onto the floor.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Shawna slipped her fingers into mine.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: She touched my sleeve. I winced.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: She stayed against my good side.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The last chorus came. Mercedes’s younger voice caught for half a breath through the speakers. Onstage, she sang alongside it, smiling. Porsche stopped laughing to listen.

timeline.speaker: SHAWNA
timeline.text: Eleven sponsors is a lot of mouths to feed.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I laughed and hurt my shoulder again.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The ticket man opened the door for another group.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: He nodded toward Mercedes, the man dancing on the coffin, and me.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: By the time the police took Silas away, the band had demanded overtime and Tank was negotiating for the leftover shrimp.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The young sound technician came over with two clean glasses. Twenty-three, little beard, still looking between Shawna and my DECEASED wrist stamp.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Nigga, apparently you can charge for it.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: My wife laughed before I opened my mouth.

timeline.speaker: SHAWNA
timeline.text: So was I. One of us remembers who saved whom.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: The technician pulled up a chair.

timeline.speaker: TANK
timeline.text: Somebody get this nigga a plate,

timeline.speaker: TANK
timeline.text: So am I. I organized a death.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Mercedes passed the young man a napkin. Porsche moved the bottle closer. He loosened the headphones around his neck and sat.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Tank dragged over another chair. Shawna sat against my good side and took one of the glasses.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I looked at the nigga who had asked.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: First night in Vegas. You want the whole thing?

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: Nigga, we still waiting on that chapter.

timeline.speaker: AIDEN
timeline.text: I took a drink. Back then, before any of these niggas knew what we'd become, the bass was shaking a different wall. Big T had his hand on my shoulder, and twelve men waited beside the cars.
